title: TermAl shows only the store's required assurance and cannot show the evaluation policy or set any store policy
outcome: An operator can see, from TermAl, which control and acceptance modes a project's store is in, and can change them with attribution, or is told the exact command that does.
acceptance: Greg's decision is recorded on whether TermAl may run the control-policy commands itself, and with what operator attribution
TermAl shows the store's required assurance, acceptance-evaluation modes, mechanical basis and source-fingerprint requirement for an Engram-enabled project
a mismatch between TermAl's toggle and the store's policy names the operator command that resolves it instead of only refusing
